frontiercode.label: FrontierCode
limitations: Main and Extended overlap. Mergeability and functional correctness are separate. Source harness and effort remain explicit.

aa-index.label: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
limitations: Composite index and components are not independent evaluations; weighted costs are distinct from per-task suite costs.

terminalbench.label: Terminal-Bench
limitations: Keep 2.0/2.1/4.0, tasks, repeats, sandbox, effort and fallback separate.

terminal-science.label: Terminal-Bench Science
limitations: Scientific terminal workflows, not all research or statistical validity.

osworld.label: OSWorld
limitations: Partial credit differs from strict task success; 82-task offline subset differs from full 108-task suite.

swe-pro.label: SWE-bench Pro / variants
limitations: Pro, Verified, Multilingual and Multimodal are separate protocols; never inherit across editions.

automationbench.label: AutomationBench
limitations: Service-side safeguards and fallback must be recorded; prerelease Haiku issue is unresolved.

gdpval.label: GDPval-AA
limitations: Relative Elo and normalized scores depend on comparison pool/date; not interchangeable with success rates.

briefcase.label: AA-Briefcase
limitations: Work product evaluation; no proof of correctness for an arbitrary analytic workflow.

scicode.label: SciCode
limitations: Code generation in scientific problems; not full research reliability.

reasoning.label: Reasoning and factuality evaluations
limitations: Separate knowledge, hallucination, instruction compliance and context reasoning. No single ranking from unrelated scales.

tau-tools.label: Tau / Toolathlon
limitations: Task definitions, tool API and success oracle differ; not a generic MCP score.

specpi.label: SpecPi controlled harness study
limitations: Overlapping pooled/sitting summaries, small nonrandom slices and historical versions; no current-harness winner.

frontierharness.label: FrontierHarness
limitations: Frozen Kimi K3 study; one trial/task, historical harness versions. Recent hash check does not refresh trial date.

composio.label: Composio SaaS harness study
limitations: Different study from terminal benchmark; denominator of cost slice differs from final-state success.

cybersecurity.label: Existing cybersecurity publications
limitations: Capability, safeguards, safety-monitor recall and attack success are separate metrics. No inference of authorization.

harnessrank.label: HarnessRank
limitations: Four published 2026-06 aggregates use historical harness versions Pi 0.79.6 / OMP 16.1.15 / OpenCode 1.17.9 / Codex 0.130.0 and GPT-5.5 medium; not current selected runtime versions.
Task denominator is 89, runs are 5 or 3; source intervals are not assumed SE or CI. Source-local result/cost relationships only; no deployed endpoint or current role equivalence.

databricks.label: Databricks coding-agent study
limitations: Internal tasks: useful context but full public task-level replication unavailable; preserve exact comparisons only.

scaffold-effect.label: The Scaffold Effect
limitations: 50-task matched model/harness study. Models are historical and confidence intervals must retain source interpretation.

minimal-mle.label: Minimal-harness MLE ablations
limitations: Self-selection and oracle selection differ. Findings are bounded to the tested ML benchmarks and budgets.

edit-format.label: Edit-format / Hashline
limitations: Tool-format interventions and edit validity are not universal harness quality; author evaluation is not independent replication.

bfcl.label: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard V4
limitations: V4 overall CSV linked by the primary loader; current capture contains historical models. Missing current 5.5 models is not a zero score. FC vs prompt modes and subtests are distinct.

mcpmark.label: MCPMark Verified
limitations: Track version, MCP service, resets and number of repeats. Dynamic empty table is not zero model capability.

webarena.label: WebArena Verified
limitations: Website state and strict task completion; distinct from GUI partial score.

workarena.label: WorkArena / BrowserGym
limitations: Controlled service workflows and task types; not equivalent to browsing arbitrary job portals.

datascibench.label: DataSciBench
limitations: Completion, success, visualization judge and weighted composite have distinct units and weights; old versions stay old.

scienceagentbench.label: ScienceAgentBench
limitations: With/without expert knowledge and agent scaffolds differ; 102 data-driven scientific tasks.

bixbench.label: BixBench
limitations: Computational-biology scope; comparative table of dataset properties is not a model performance table.

bird-interact.label: BIRD-Interact
limitations: Interactive database state, user simulator and efficiency; distinguish full and lite conditions.

livesqlbench.label: LiveSQLBench
limitations: Date/version and category splits may differ. Cost is recorded only with its source denominator.

deepscholar.label: DeepScholar-Bench
limitations: Retrieval, synthesis, citation precision and claim coverage are independent constructs; report generation systems are not bare models.

deepresearch2.label: DeepResearch Bench II
limitations: Expert rubrics; information recall, analysis and presentation distinct. Historical agent configurations stay historical.

swe-prbench.label: SWE-PRBench
limitations: Frozen A/B/C context configurations; detection and false positives are not implementation success.

codereview.label: CodeReviewBench
limitations: F1, precision, recall and cost per PR/bug must remain separate; do not guess which metric a displayed CI belongs to.

longmemeval.label: LongMemEval
limitations: Oracle/short/medium memory scope and retrieval/reading setup are distinct. No equivalence with nominal context capacity.

skillsbench.label: SkillsBench 1.1
limitations: Paired with/without-skills comparisons only; cross-model comparisons are not causal skill effects.

hal-reliability.label: HAL Reliability
limitations: Accuracy, consistency, predictability, robustness and safety distinct; means are not reliability distributions.

agentdojo.label: AgentDojo
limitations: Benign utility, utility under attack and adversarial success separate. No executable attack payloads are emitted by this lab.

qwen-public.label: Qwen Flash-Next model card
limitations: Publisher source, not a NaN deployment evaluation; no automatic equality between Flash-Next checkpoint and NaN Flash label.

uncatalogued.label: Other captured metrics — classification pending
limitations: Explicit unresolved suite. Do not infer coverage from substring counts or consider unknown metrics performance.

vals-professional.label: Vals professional-task evaluations
limitations: Benchmarks/version/effort and sample sizes differ; ranks are not denominators.

document-work.label: Document work products
limitations: Source-local task and score definitions retained.

data-engineering.label: Data / SRE tasks
limitations: Source-local task and score definitions retained.

aa-benchmark-under-review.note: Estado observado en la página primaria de AA el 2026-10-10. Conservar las celdas históricas; no utilizarlas para admitir candidatas ni inferir validez científica.

harnessrank-historical-harness.label: HarnessRank report evaluates historical harness versions, not the current Agent Profile Lab targets
harnessrank-historical-harness.note: Aggregates for GPT-5.5 medium, Pi v0.79.6, OMP v16.1.15, OpenCode v1.17.9 and Codex v0.130.0. Valid source-local historical comparison, never a direct comparison of the user’s current installed harnesses.

modelLinks.policy: Exact source label or publisher slug only; no punctuation stripping, prefix/fuzzy matching, or variant inheritance.

candidateRelations.reason: Service label and open checkpoint may differ; do not use as exact-model evidence.

limitations: Counts are scalar observations, not independent trials.
Source-local comparability is not cross-harness equivalence.
Published model matches do not establish endpoint or credential performance.
Unknown metric/protocol fields remain unresolved and excluded from automatic screening.
Public evidence view includes only license-reviewed permitted observation families.
External linked-only evidence cannot be used to reproduce the complete private corpus; unchanged source profile decisions are not recalibrated.

provenance.validationNote: The 2,496 original profile routes and 33,414 active source assignments are preserved verbatim. No profile decisions are recomputed.

data.label: Análisis de datos
data.gate: Verificar grano, unidades, denominadores, missing, joins, estimador, supuestos e interpretación. Oráculo numérico/simulación y trazabilidad; test verde no acredita validez científica.
data.critical: Inferencia estadística, decisiones de medida y semántica de datos
data.routine: Transformaciones y gráficos con especificación y valores esperados
data.scope: R/Python/SQL, psicometría, SEM, procesos analíticos reproducibles

research.label: Investigación
research.gate: Lectura de fuentes primarias, citas que soporten cada afirmación, búsqueda de evidencia contraria y distinción dato/inferencia. No inventar bibliografía; comprobar cifras originales.
research.critical: Síntesis, inferencia, diseño del estudio y validez de evidencia
research.routine: Búsqueda, extracción y clasificación con fuente y alcance explícitos
research.scope: Literatura, investigación empírica y síntesis; tráfico compatible con términos del proveedor

web.label: Desarrollo web
web.gate: Tests de comportamiento, accesibilidad, responsive, estados de error y revisión visual. Privacidad, autorización y cobros requieren revisión fuerte aunque el UI sea simple.
web.critical: Arquitectura, contratos, permisos, estado y persistencia
web.routine: UI y componentes delimitados con capturas y pruebas
web.scope: Frontend, backend y aplicaciones web; distinto del software nativo/CLI/multiplataforma. Una nota visual alta no demuestra seguridad ni corrección.

apps.label: Desarrollo de software
apps.gate: Ejecutar CI en cada SO objetivo, comprobar rutas/case/encoding, permisos, procesos/IPC, ciclo de vida, instalación/actualización y persistencia. Compilar sólo en Linux no valida Windows/macOS.
apps.critical: Interfaz nativa, concurrencia, IPC, empaquetado y ciclo de vida
apps.routine: Componentes y módulos portables con contratos y matriz de CI
apps.scope: Software nativo, CLI, GUI, servicios y desarrollo multiplataforma para Windows, macOS, Linux y móvil; distinto del frontend/backend web.

cybersecurity.label: Ciberseguridad
cybersecurity.gate: Exigir alcance, activos y autorización explícitos antes de actuar; proteger secretos y datos sensibles; reproducir hallazgos en un entorno aislado con evidencia verificable; validar remediación y no regresión; revisión humana del impacto. No ejecutar acciones destructivas, persistentes ni contra sistemas reales fuera de la autorización documentada.
cybersecurity.critical: Fronteras de confianza, identidad y permisos, explotación e impacto, exposición de secretos, evaluación de vulnerabilidades y decisiones de remediación
cybersecurity.routine: Tareas defensivas acotadas y autorizadas con activos, límites y oráculo de aceptación explícitos; pruebas reproducibles aisladas, sin acciones sobre objetivos reales no autorizadas
cybersecurity.scope: Revisión defensiva, modelado de amenazas, endurecimiento y evaluación autorizada en laboratorio o activos expresamente incluidos en alcance; no implica autorización para intrusión ni acredita competencia o eficacia en ciberseguridad
cybersecurity.evidenceNote: Las rutas de ciberseguridad se derivan de perfiles equivalentes de Apps y reutilizan la revisión crítica existente cuando está justificada. Hay resultados públicos de benchmarks incorporados con fuente y correspondencia explícitas, pero no establecen calibración ni equivalencia de proveedor, selector o harness de nuestras rutas. La validación estructural no demuestra seguridad, calidad ni eficacia.

agent-use.label: Agent use (uso de computador)
agent-use.gate: Acción reversible o confirmada; log de acciones con diff de estado; límites de autorización explícitos. Ni escrituras destructivas sin confirmación ni credenciales en captures.
agent-use.critical: Planificación multi-app, autorización, recuperación de errores y juicio de reversibilidad
agent-use.routine: Flujos delimitados con oráculo verificable (OSWorld-style) y capturas
agent-use.scope: Computer use: navegador, SO, apps de escritorio; proxies públicos: OSWorld 2.0, Agents' Last Exam, ScreenSpot-Pro, Arena Agent
